tags.description: Sentier vers Lydi plage
Route from Apikia to reach the beach of Gialia following the valley of Pithara down to the sea and continue on the coastal trail that takes hikers to Chora (8a).
tags.name: Andros Routes 8

tags.description: This route starts by the Factory (Fabrika tou Ebeirikou) and conncets Gialia beach with Chora, via a mostly seaside trail that ascends to pass the ridge that stands betweeen the two seaside areas.
tags.name: Andros Routes 8a

tags.description: This route starts from Chora and takes hikers up to the mountainous village of Vourkoti, passing through wide paved trails, picturesque settlements and beautiful landscapes.
tags.name: Andros Routes 2

tags.description: This short route, less than one kilometer long, leads the hikers from the settlement of Apikia to the Waterfalls of Pithara.
tags.name: Andros Routes 2a

tags.description: This short route leads hikers from the entrance of Aegea Hotel to the cave named Trypes with a unique view of the Aegean sea. Note that one will need a flashlight and some climbing skills in order to acces the cave.
tags.name: Andros Routes 20

tags.description: This hike connects Chora and Korthi beach, through the closest to the eastern seaside settlements and along traditionally built trails. A stone arched bridge and a unique castle overviewing the entire region await!
tags.name: Andros Routes 3

tags.description: Take this beautiful trail from Arni down to the beautiful Lefka Beach, following a scenic valley.
tags.name: Andros Routes 13

tags.description: Route stretching parallel to the biggest river of Andros, Achla, towards the homonymous beach. Finely-crafted old farm houses, the beautiful arched bridge of Achla, the old Agios Nikolaos Monastery are some of the many attractions.
tags.name: Andros Routes 6

tags.description: This route leads from Aidonia higher above the Bay of Korthi to the monastery of Tromarchia on the slopes above the western coastline of Andros. Traditional settlements and agricultural land make up the background for the most of this route.
tags.name: Andros Routes 4

tags.description: One of the longest trails of Andros takes hikers on a route from Gavrio up to Ammolochos and down through the valley of the watermills to the village called Frousei.
tags.name: Andros Routes 14

tags.description: Starting from Agios Petros, this route descends towards the seaside settlement of Batsi through the typican backcountry of Andros.
tags.name: Andros Routes 16

tags.description: Take this route to explore the archaelogic findings both in the museum of Paleopolis and in the arcahelogical site of the ancient port. Steep though the route may be the sights are more than worth it.
tags.name: Andros Routes 9a

tags.description: This route connects the sea-side settlement of Batsi with the mountainous village of Arni through wide trails, small settlements and with beautiful views that leave a pleasant impression.
tags.name: Andros Routes 11

tags.description: The most mountaineering-like of Andros routes. This hike connects two mountainous villages of Andros, Vourkoti and Arni, through a trail along the highest ridge of Andros, with unique views along the way
tags.name: Andros Routes 12

tags.description: Trail to Chora-Ypsilou-Lamyra-Menites-Stoicheiwmeni bridge-Panachrados Monastery
tags.name: Andros Routes 1

tags.description: This route connects the settlement of Vakoni with Chora, through a series of beautiful settlements, while circumnavigating the watershed of Gerakonas.
tags.name: Andros Routes 18

tags.description: This route offers another connection (additional to that of route 3) between Korthi and Chora, through the backcountry of Andros and some picturesque villages higher up on the mountainous terrain that separates the two
tags.name: Andros Routes 5

tags.description: Take this long route stepping on old paved trails from Ano Aprovatou, above the west coast, to reach the settlement of Strapouries, near the capital of the island on the east side.
tags.name: Andros Routes 9

tags.description: This trail connects the settlements of Mesathouri and Apikia through a mountain saddle and a beautiful forest.
tags.name: Andros Routes 10

tags.description: A relatively short, circular route takes hikers from Chora to Livadia, circumventing "Megalos Potamos", the big ravine that drains the watershed of Gerakonas.
tags.name: Andros Routes 17

tags.description: This route begins at Panachrantou Monastery, the highest area in ​​the Chora watershed. and descends to the western side of the island, in order to meet the archaeological site of Zagora, in a breathtaking balcony over the Aegean sea.
tags.name: Andros Routes 7

tags.description: Take this small circular trail to visit the settlement of Scholi before coming back to route 15
tags.name: Andros Routes 15a

tags.description: Starting from outside of Gavrio this route takes hikers to the settlement of Ano Agios Petros, and then down to the ancient tower on the way to the beach of Agios Petros.
tags.name: Andros Routes 15

tags.description: This uphill route connects the settlement of Livadia with route 1, higher up the Gerakonas massif. Along route 1 one can hike to the monastery of Panachrantou.
tags.name: Andros Routes 17a

tags.description: Take this impressive wide paved trail above the western coast of Andros, starting just outside of Batsi, to reach Ano Aprovatou where route 9 begins.
tags.name: Andros Routes 11a

tags.description: Nice circular route exploring the fertile Menites valley. The impressive springs of Menites, the church of Panagia Koumoulou, the valley with the tower houses and the churches, the watermill ruins along the ravine are just some of the attractions
tags.name: Menites Circular Route

tags.description: Starting at Piso Meria, this route takes hikers over the last mountain of Andros to the south to drop them down to the beach of Stavros with views of Tinos island.
tags.name: Andros Routes 19

tags.description: This is one of two very short sibling routes, that explore the residential network of the small village of Ano Katakoilos. Suitable for a quick family walk. Unfortunately both trails need work to restore accessibility
tags.name: Katakoilos Circular Route 2

tags.description: This is one of two very short sibling routes, that explore the residential network of the small village of Ano Katakoilos. Suitable for a quick family walk. Unfortunately both trails need work to restore accessibility
tags.name: Katakoilos Circular Route 1

tags.description: This circular route will take hiker from Piso Meria to the monastery of Tromarchia on a breathtaking hike above the western coastline of Andros.
tags.name: Tromarchia Circular Route

tags.description: This route circles around the extended residential network of Arni, passing by agricultural land, cottages and churches as well as the famous stone arched bridge of Epameinondas.
tags.name: Arni Circular Route

tags.description: This small circular route connects the neigbourhoods of Ano Aprovatou with the beach of Koutsi and Kato Aprovatou through scenic trails and with great views.
